articles.title: Bitcoin developers flag 85 critical bugs in an "extremely bad" situation
articles.snippet: A volunteer group running AI models against bitcoin codebases says it is averaging roughly one critical bug per hour per person, at about $10,000 a day in compute.

articles.title: Crypto may have institutionalized, but it still trades like a rumor mill
articles.snippet: The more institutional crypto becomes, the more it prices on headlines. The edge now is reading the positioning data underneath, not reacting to the narrative on top.
